verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own docs cover the visual-editor part of the story: a drag-and-drop editor, a Simple editor and a custom HTML editor with live preview. The evidence does not document reusable email templates (the only template mention is for landing pages, a different feature), personalization tokens, or rendering across email clients. Missing for 10: reusable email template library, personalization/merge tokens, cross-client rendering assurance, on-brand style controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Three editors, a drag and drop editor, a distraction-free Simple editor and a custom HTML editor with live preview.
Create engaging, dynamic emails in minutes with our intuitive drag & drop email editor.
